def test_total_units_sums_all_skus():
    # Spec: total_units() returns the sum of all stock levels.
    s = Stock()
    s.add("widget", 5)
    s.add("gadget", 2)
    s.add("widget", 3)
    assert s.total_units() == 10


def test_total_units_of_empty_stock_is_zero():
    assert Stock().total_units() == 0


def test_total_units_after_remove():
    s = Stock()
    s.add("widget", 5)
    s.add("gadget", 4)
    s.remove("widget", 2)
    assert s.total_units() == 7
EOF
